summary: Permit exact stock plugin manifests to upgrade across package versions while protecting custom assets.

decisions.problem: R3 stock plugin manifests blocked cross-version regeneration.
decisions.choice: Recognize only the exact generated manifest rendered with a supported prior version; keep other asset ownership checks.
decisions.rationale: Allows stock development/release upgrades while retaining custom metadata, formatting, and runtime protection.
